findings.title: Unsupported root NodePath reaches native resolver before validation
findings.observed: player.get_node_or_null(root_path) executes before the is_absolute/is_empty/subname checks. The supported scene is detached.
findings.impact: Pinned Node::get_node_or_null has ERR_FAIL_COND_V_MSG for an absolute path outside the tree, so the failure path produces an avoidable engine diagnostic before explicit capture refusal. This contradicts rejecting unsupported paths before lookup.
findings.source: Pinned node.cpp1892-1898; exact hash in API-RESEARCH-BINDINGS.json
findings.required_change: Record root_path first, reject absolute/empty/subname paths with a lookup omission marker, and call the native resolver only after shape admission; retain actual resolved root identity thereafter.
findings.validation: Static order check and independent synthetic resolver-trap control for invalid root paths; no native execution.

findings.title: Settings metadata failure escapes instead of preserving refusal receipt
findings.observed: Facts.typed raises uncaught ValueError while building settings comprehension for NaN/Inf scalar settings or unsupported queue metadata. Independent194-case suite reproduces4failures.
findings.impact: No partial returned receipt and model differs from native refusal path.
findings.required_change: Capture settings incrementally, preserve prior raw settings and current failure marker, translate metadata failure to Refusal. Match source distinction between scalar _typed and queue Facts.typed.

other_observations: Single C248 chain ownership and no double close correctly retained
Actual target ID association does not depend on source names or track order
RESET special key is explicitly refused
Final scene/resource rechecks and two inventories limit lasting drift claims
No native parse or runtime evidence claimed
